channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Hands Victories to Putin, Who Offers More War in Return
item.description: Russia has reaped a diesel deal and an increase in U.S. pressure on Ukraine as President Trump’s political needs align with his longstanding inclinations toward Russia.

item.title: NPR: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
item.description: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

item.title: BBC News: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
item.description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

item.title: The Guardian: Could I make six figures from my couch? Influencers said yes – so I tried
item.description: I was seduced by creators hawking passive income hustles. Like the language used in MLMs, it seemed too good to be true A very specific kind of content began taking over my social media feeds at the end of last year. I h…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Floods submerge cars, homes and hospitals in Libya’s Tripoli
item.description: Heavy rainfall triggered flooding in Libya’s capital, Tripoli, submerging cars, trapping people inside buildings.

item.title: Ars Technica: High-speed video reveals how honey bee stingers pump venom
item.description: Co-author: “The unique geometry of the valves is the key; they act as collapsible pistons" to deliver venom.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
item.description: In a world of AI Overviews, Wikipedia usage declines. But the real loss may be far more existential than website traffic.

item.title: WIRED Science: They War-Gamed Dimming the Sun. It Went Even Worse Than You Think
item.description: Solar geoengineering could buy humanity time against climate change—or trigger a dangerous new arms race. A first-of-its-kind simulation offered a glimpse of what happens when geopolitics takes the wheel.

item.title: WIRED Business: Alex Gibney’s ‘Musk’ Has a Unique Perspective on Daddy Issues
item.description: Elon Musk’s father, Errol Musk, agreed to be interviewed immediately.

item.title: The New Yorker: Pity the Poor Passport
item.description: Americans’ most valued official document is the latest national treasure to get a Trump makeover.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Selma Blair Pleads Not Guilty to Assault After Plane Incident
item.description: The actress is facing state and federal charges after allegedly injuring two flight attendants, a police officer, and a nurse.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: An 1870 1-Bedroom With Skylights and Fireplace in Brooklyn Heights for $945,000
item.description: And an Upper West Side one-bedroom in an Emery Roth co-op right across from Central Park.
